name: Thermax Limited
summary: Thermax Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides energy and environment solutions in India and internationally. The company is involved in the manufacturing, installation, sales, and services related to boilers and heating equipment, absorption chiller/heat pumps, air pollution control equipment/systems, water and waste recycling; and provision of associated services and engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC).
